t: Quanta Tracker: Heisenberg Budget Desk — Simple
name: Quanta Tracker: Heisenberg Budget Desk — Simple
title: Quanta Tracker: Heisenberg Budget Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Δx·Δp ≥ ħ/2 prices every measurement: the desk computes the momentum kick for any position resolution. Locating an electron to 1 nm costs ≥5.3×10⁻²⁶ kg·m/s of momentum uncertainty — the budget no tracker escapes.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Momentum uncertainty at Δx=1 nm = 5.27e-26 kg·m/s. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Quanta Tracker and the Infinite Lens
real_world_basis: Heisenberg budgeting is the real, physical basis of quantum measurement.
signature_version: Signature version: the infinite-lens uncertainty desk — the chapter's Infinite Lens as the resolution target, with the infinite framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the budget is a floor — engineer above it, never through it.
math_note: Momentum uncertainty at Δx=1 nm: 5.27e-26 kg·m/s [verified]; Momentum uncertainty at Δx=1 pm: 5.27e-23 kg·m/s [verified]
safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a resolution claimed past the floor.
how_it_works: Divide ħ/2 by the position resolution for the momentum uncertainty. The demo budgets three probes.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact

t: Quanta Tracker: Backaction Analyzer — Simple
name: Quanta Tracker: Backaction Analyzer — Simple
title: Quanta Tracker: Backaction Analyzer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Measuring kicks: the analyzer computes the measurement backaction on the tracked system — the probe's momentum transfer vs the system's dynamics. A tracker that destroys the trajectory isn't tracking.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Backaction ratio: kick 5e-26 vs ion momentum 1e-22 = 5.0e-04 ratio. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Quanta Tracker and the Infinite Lens
real_world_basis: Backaction analysis is the real basis of quantum non-demolition design.
signature_version: Signature version: the infinite-lens backaction desk — the chapter's lens as the gentleness target, with the infinite framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the weakest probe that still resolves — gentleness is engineered.
math_note: Backaction ratio: kick 5e-26 vs ion momentum 1e-22: 5.0e-04 ratio [verified]; Binary entropy at p=0.5 kick split: 1.0 bit [verified]

Binary entropy at p=0.5 kick split

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a 'non-demolition' claim without the kick budget.
how_it_works: Compare the backaction kick to the system's momentum scale. The demo tracks a trapped ion.
